Glenview Capital Management Has Decreased Its Holding in Anthem (ANTM) as Stock Value Declined; Kahn Brothers Group Continues to Hold Holding in Mbia (MBI)
May 16, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Irving Kahn increased its stake in Mbia (MBI) by 54.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kahn Brothers Group Inc bought 1.61M shares as the company’s stock rose 20.44% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Irving Kahn held 4.59 million shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $33.60 billion, up from 2.98 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kahn Brothers Group Inc who had been investing in Mbia for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $784.02 million market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $8.66. About 356,234 shares traded. MBIA Inc. (NYSE:MBI) has risen 14.09% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.54% the S&P500.
Larry Robbins decreased its stake in Anthem Inc (ANTM) by 19.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Glenview Capital Management Llc sold 745,018 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.73% with the market. The hedge fund run by Larry Robbins held 3.06 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $687.97M, down from 3.80 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Glenview Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Anthem Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $59.20B market cap company. The stock increased 0.49% or $1.12 during the last trading session, reaching $231.99. About 309,772 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500.
